latest_release.body:
# Zen Stable Release


## Security
- https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-130/

## New Features
- Updated to Firefox 160.0.1
- The copy URL and copy URL as Markdown shortcuts now copy the URLs of all selected tabs when multiple tabs are selected.

## Fixes
- Fixed boosts color tinting and controls not working. ([#16586](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/16586))
- Fixed closed browser and popup windows never being freed from memory, which made memory usage and pauses grow over time. ([#16587](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/16587))
- Switching spaces is now smooth when spaces use gradient themes, instead of being choppy. ([#13029](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/13029))
- Fixed tabs shown in a split view or behind a glance being unloaded when memory runs low. ([#16624](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/16624))
- Fixed Spaces Sync for spaces and pinned tabs assigned to the built-in containers (Personal, Work, Banking, Shopping) on profiles that don't have them. Missing containers are now created when needed. ([#16614](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/16614))
- Fixed the copy URL shortcut copying "about:blank" while a page is still loading. ([#16510](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/16510))
- Improved performance when opening new windows with mods installed. ([#16674](https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/issues/16674))
- Fixed thin lines in PDFs printing as thick black boxes on some printers on Windows.
- Fixed PDFs, web page graphics, and WebGL content appearing blank or broken on Macs with AMD graphics, such as black cells in Google Sheets.
- Fixed incorrect colors in WebGL and canvas content, such as games and Google Meet backgrounds, on some Linux systems using Wayland.
- Fixed links on some sites, such as the Google Store, taking a very long time to load.
- Fixed tabs crashing on some sites, most notably ChatGPT.
- Fixed WebTransport connections being unable to send datagrams after a site sent many in quick succession.
- Fixed trackpad and mouse swipes sometimes scrolling the page when a site had blocked scrolling.
- More bug fixes and improvements.

## Changes
- The zoom level button is now hidden in the single toolbar layout. A toast shows the current zoom level when you change it instead.
